Animal de estimação na cabine

A pet permitted to travel in the aircraft cabin with the passenger, subject to airline policies and operational restrictions; denoted as PETC.

In this glossary, Animal de estimação na cabine refers to: A pet permitted to travel in the aircraft cabin with the passenger, subject to airline policies and operational restrictions; denoted as PETC.
